annotation.authors_or_issuer: 商务部、国家发展改革委、工业和信息化部、财政部、农业农村部、文化和旅游部、市场监管总局
annotation.summary_en: Seven-ministry implementation opinion on expanding and upgrading goods consumption in China to 2030. Covers autos, appliances, silver-economy products, green and AI-enabled smart consumption, standards and financial support. Embodied AI appears incidentally: exoskeleton robots for elderly homes, smart robots, smart-connected vehicles, and smart-home standards.
annotation.title_clean: 商务部等7部门关于推动商品消费扩容升级的实施意见
annotation.title_en: Implementation Opinions of the Ministry of Commerce and Six Other Departments on Promoting the Expansion and Upgrading of Goods Consumption
annotation.venue: 商务部 (Ministry of Commerce of China)
key_provisions_or_claims: Target retail sales of about 60 trillion yuan by 2030, with green, smart and health consumption as ten-trillion-yuan markets
Promote exoskeleton robots, electric wheelchairs and smart care devices in elderly households; explore a silver-product certification system
Build national AI application pilot bases for consumer products and promote smart robots, smart homes and wearables
Accelerate standards for smart-connected vehicles, smart home interoperability and AI terminals
Provide fiscal interest subsidies and financial support for autos, appliances and smart-home consumption
